## Checklist

- [ ] The description is one sentence, factual, and does not repeat the name.
- [ ] Tags match the legend (only when relevant).
- [ ] The URL is not already present elsewhere in the list.
- [ ] The resource is defensive; it does not help build or deploy spyware.
- [ ] I have disclosed it if I maintain the linked project.
- [ ] `node scripts/build-index.mjs` was run and `data/index.json` / `llms.txt` are committed.
- [ ] `npx awesome-lint` passes locally.
